articleTitle: Knowledge graph construction for cross enterprise product supply relationship of intelligent instruments
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: The massive resources of intelligent instruments provide data support for cross enterprise regional network collaborative manufacturing. However, the discrete distribution of data, a large amount of redundancy, and weak correlation limit system knowledge learning. This paper proposes an automatic construction method of a knowledge graph for the supply and demand matching of products and the relationship between upstream and downstream enterprises. Firstly, Stanford CoreNLP tool is used to achieve enterprise entity recognition. Secondly, considering the potential relationship between boundary words and product keywords, an improved CRF model is proposed to achieve product entity recognition. Then, a method for extracting enterprise products supply relationships based on relationship indicator lexicon and dependency syntax analysis is proposed to obtain the upstream and downstream relationships of enterprise products. Finally, the Neo4j database is used to store the knowledge graph of cross enterprise product supply relationship of intelligent instruments, and it is published on a third-party service platform to promote efficient resource sharing and collaborative manufacturing of intelligent instruments across enterprises.

articleTitle: Optimizing multi-input scheduling for fuzzing test using Bayesian algorithm weight optimization
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: As a major software testing method, fuzzing has the potential to enhance testing coverage and detect a great number of software vulnerabilities in complex code programs. The current fuzzy testing for multiple input parameters lacks an effective calling mechanism and treats all variant parameter equally, resulting in low efficiency. This paper presents a fuzzy testing method based on Bayesian algorithm for scheduling parameters. Firstly, it combines the characteristics of input parameters to match the appropriate variation strategy. Secondly, it utlizes the Bayesian algorithm to automatically generate weight values for the objective function index during sufficient testing. It evaluates test cases with multi-parameter inputs according to these weights and selects parameters with high utilization value for multiple tests. Finally, in order to evaluate the effectiveness of the method of this paper, an application programming interface of Amercian fuzzy lop (AFL-API) is developed based on the typical fuzzy testing tool AFL++, and compared with AFL++ as a fuzzy testing tool. The experimental results demonstate that when using the AFL-API for program testing, there was 47% increase in coverage rate, 52% increase in the number of discovered crashes, and more program vulnerabilities were identified during actual testing.

articleTitle: Clothing pressure test device design and application
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: In this paper, a garment pressure test device is designed through the study of garment pressure test device and method. It mainly introduces the hardware equipment FlexiForce sensors, analog circuit converters, power adapters, and data acquisition cards to build the test device, and the system for measuring garment pressure values is programmed through the graphical programming language LabVIEW development tool, which mainly contains the functions of data acquisition, storage, analysis and processing, and display, and the device is calibrated for testing the The device was calibrated to test the pressure of garments worn on different parts of the human body. By testing the pressure value of elastic fabric products worn by the human body, the test site is selected as the minimum circumference of the ankle, the gastrocnemius muscle stop, the maximum circumference of the calf and the lower end of the tibial tuberosity of four transverse test lines, each of the four transverse test lines is divided into eight equal parts, a total of 32 test points, the test verifies the actual testing effect of the garment pressure testing device, and finds that the device is accurate and stable, and can be used for the study of the pressure comfort of the garment and the later design and production of the device. It is found that the device is accurate and stable, and can be used as a reference for studying the comfort of the pressure and the later design and production of garments.

articleTitle: Health evaluation of transmission mechanism in powertrain based on composite weight cloud model
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: The performance degradation of the powertrain in service significantly affects the stability and reliability of tracked vehicles. To assess the powertrain health state of tracked vehicles, this study proposes a health state evaluation method for the transmission mechanism of the powertrain based on a composite weight cloud model. Firstly, the model establishes a health evaluation indexes system for the transmission mechanism, calculates the subjective index weights based on the AHP method and utilizes the EWM-CRITIC method to compute the objective index weights. However, the subjective and objective weights have some limitations. Therefore, the weights of subjective and objective indexes are fused through the game theory to obtain the composite weights of indexes. Secondly, this research categorizes the health status levels of the transmission mechanism to establish an evaluation standard cloud model and combines index weights and data to generate a comprehensive cloud model. Then, the cloud memberships are calculated for different mileage comprehensive clouds to quantitatively analyse the cloud model. Finally, the feasibility of the composite weight cloud model health evaluation method is verified by comparing it with other health evaluation methods, which provides a reference for the health state evaluation of the powertrain.

articleTitle: Research on weak signal demodulation algorithm of orthogonal Fabry-Perot cavity fibre optic acoustic sensor
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: The ellipse fitting (EF) algorithm has attracted extensive attention in phase demodulation schemes for eliminating nonlinear errors. When the amplitude of the phase change of the interference spectrum caused by the signal to be measured is weak, the error of EF results is large, which leads to the failure of EF and differential-cross-multiplying (EF-DCM) demodulation. This paper proposes a presetting ellipse parameters and differential-cross-multiplying (PEP-DCM) demodulation scheme based on an orthogonal Fabry–Perot fibre optic acoustic sensor. When the sensing system is sensitive to strong sound pressure signals, a set of reliable elliptic parameter solution results are utilised as the preset values of elliptic fitting parameters for correcting the EF results of weak signals, which in turn improves the demodulation effectiveness of weak sound pressure signals. The scheme and the EF-DCM algorithm are simulated for demodulation. The two algorithms' effectiveness for demodulating weak sound pressure signals are compared and analysed. The feasibility of the PEP-DCM scheme for demodulating weak signals is verified through experiments. The experimental results show that the PEP-DCM algorithm is more accurate and stable for demodulating weak signals.

articleTitle: Prognostic prediction of electroacupuncture for low back pain based on surface electromyographic map and CNN-SE model
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: Chronic low back pain (CLBP) is a common and refractory musculoskeletal disease, which seriously affects patients' work and life. Electroacupuncture (EA) has become a popular method for the treatment of CLBP due to its advantages of high safety and few side effects, but its effect is still controversial. One of the important reasons is that individual differences make EA therapy not effective for everyone. Through machine learning method, the therapeutic effect prediction model was constructed from the surface electromyography (sEMG) data shows potential to help screen patients suitable for specific treatments efficiency. Thus, this study aims to establish a prediction model for EA treatment of CLBP by using convolutional neural network (CNN) based on sEMG topographic map. Each map was categorized with a label according to the changes of pain indicators. The results show that the prediction accuracy of CNN-SE (Squeeze-and-Excitation) model proposed in this study is 75%, which proves the potential of CNN-SE model to predict the efficacy of EA. This study initially confirmed the effectiveness of the EA effect prediction model for CLBP based on multi-channel sEMG signal, which is also of great significance for further research on the pathogenesis and treatment optimization of CLBP.

articleTitle: Key testing techniques for helicopter near ground flight safety monitoring
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: Helicopters are widely used in the field of general aviation due to their excellent low altitude performance. As a key capability of helicopter flight performance, ground maneuver flight is an important subject in helicopter flight testing. In order to ensure the safety and controllability of helicopters during ground maneuver flight tests, it is necessary to monitor some key parameters during helicopter flight in real-time. In response to the testing requirements for close range measurement of rotor and tail rotor, real-time monitoring and warning of aircraft near ground altitude during helicopter flight tests, key technologies such as matrix laser ranging technology and platform control algorithm were studied to determine the design scheme of key testing technologies for helicopter near ground flight. Based on this, the helicopter near ground flight safety monitoring and warning system developed has achieved helicopter near ground flight safety monitoring, which has important reference significance for the design of future helicopter flight test systems.

articleTitle: A study on chip delay measurement sensor based on scan chain
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: The reliability and performance of integrated circuits degrade over time, with one critical factor being the aging of numerous internal combinational logic circuits. Delay variations in these circuits not only reflect the chip's external environmental conditions but also indicate the degree of aging during its operational life. Traditional aging delay measurement sensors typically employ dedicated sampling circuits, which pose challenges for comprehensive detection of delays across all combinational logic paths within the chip. This study introduces a novel chip aging sensor, termed the FATE-Sensor, which leverages the internal scan chains of the chip. By performing a full-chip frequency scan of the combinational logic circuits, the FATE-Sensor can detect delay variations at various combinational logic locations using the extensive coverage provided by the scan chains. This paper presents a detailed investigation of the FATE-Sensor's characteristics, including its consistency, repeatability, temperature and voltage dependencies, and resolution enhancement. Experimental calibration of the FATE-Sensor demonstrates its effectiveness in monitoring and reflecting delay variations within the chip's internal circuits. This capability allows for accurate assessment of the chip path delay status, thus enhancing the reliability of chips used in high-precision and advanced applications. This technology not only aids in identifying potential faulty chips and supports chip timing verification testing but also provides new insights for understanding and extending chip lifespan.

articleTitle: Easy augmented reality
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: This paper introduces the design and implementation process of an AR project, aiming to embed virtual objects into videos. Firstly, the world coordinate system is fixed and the three-dimensional world coordinates of the object to be rendered are set. Then, camera intrinsic calibration is completed, including distortion parameters. Afterwards, the PnP algorithm is used to solve the rotation and translation relationship between the world coordinate system and the camera coordinate system in each frame, projecting the three-dimensional coordinates of the rendering object onto the image. This paper focuses on the implementation of the PnP algorithm, calculating the relationship between the world coordinate system and the camera coordinate system through feature point tracking and PnP calculation. The algorithm process is divided into four steps, including initial pose estimation, cube projection, optical flow tracking, and continuous PnP pose calculation. In actual operation, there are sources of error, including intrinsic errors, world coordinate point errors, and instability in PnP calculations. Overall, by combining the PnP algorithm with real-time optical flow tracking technology, the project achieves the goal of dynamically inserting virtual objects into videos, providing a new method for the application of augmented reality technology.

articleTitle: Design of highly uniformity planar grid coils for obtaining near-zero magnetic field in magnetoencephalogram
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: Magnetoencephalography (MEG) based on optically pumped magnetometers has the ability to passively detect the extremely weak magnetic field signals, which is of crucial significance in the diagnosis and treatment of cerebral disorders. A highly uniform magnetic field produced by the uniform coil is required during the MEG measurement. In this paper, a novel design method for planar gird coil is proposed to obtain a high uniform magnetic field with a simpler coil structure. The finite element simulation results indicate that the space utilization ratio of the coils reaches 8% under the limit of 2% maximum inhomogeneity. The designed planar grid coils can achieve high homogeneity within a large uniform region, which is suitable for the active magnetic field compensation system to create a near-zero magnetic field environment during MEG measurement.

articleTitle: Preparation of PVDF films by electrospinning and their application in a human posture recognition system
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: This study prepared polyvinylidene fluoride/zinc oxide (PVDF/ZnO) piezoelectric films using electrospinning. The films were characterized using scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and X-ray diffraction (XRD), and their performance was tested to determine the optimal ZnO doping ratio of 15 wt%. Sensor sensitive elements were created using screen printing, and a non-array sensor layout was designed, resulting in a tactile sensor cushion. A pressure data acquisition system was developed using a microcontroller to collect sitting posture data. A posture recognition system was built using a support vector machine (SVM) classification algorithm, achieving a recognition accuracy of 88.33% with different kernel functions. Finally, the pressure distribution on the sensor array was displayed through a graphical interface.

articleTitle: Optimization of eye-in-hand calibration methods
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: Hand-eye calibration is a vital part in the field of robot vision and motion control, which ensures that the robot system can accurately perceive and operate the surrounding environment. To enhance the accuracy of the hand-eye calibration matrix obtained in the current experimental environment, this paper provides an optimal scheme for the selection of calibration points and hand-eye calibration algorithms on the checkerboard calibration board. The geometric errors, rotation-translation errors and other parameters of Tsai algorithm and Navy algorithm were calculated based on multiple sets of experimental data, and the performance differences between the two algorithms were evaluated. The experimental results show that in the calibration environment of this experiment, the optimal selection number of marker points is about 12, and the optimal calibration algorithm is Tsai algorithm. This study provides a reference for the optimization of robotic hand-eye calibration technology.

articleTitle: Lightweight Mars surface detection algorithm based on improved Yolov7
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: Mars surface detection is a challenging task that takes into account environmental factors such as terrain complexity, ground flatness, rock distribution, geological features, and storms. In this paper, we address the complexity of rock distribution on the surface of Mars and the resource-constrained difficulties of intelligences in performing the task, and propose the Yolov7- MFGC model on top of Yolov7, which solves the problems of existing rock detection models in terms of large computational load and number of parameters, as well as resource constraints in a specific environment. In this paper, we use a homemade Mars surface rock dataset for training and testing, and the test results show that Yolov7-MFGC improves the accuracy by 1.7%, reduces the amount of parameters by 49%, shrinks the model volume by 49.6%, and reduces the GFLOPS by 70% compared with Yolov7. Therefore, it can be concluded that Yolov7-MFGC is able to better perform the Mars surface rock detection task.

articleTitle: Design and simulation of marine rocking reduction device based on control torque gyro
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: When a ship sails, it will be impacted by the waves and obtain transverse rocking, which greatly affects the safe operation of the ship's equipment and the feeling of the =sailors. The traditional gyro stabilizer reduces the rocking of the ship as a whole, but the application of rocking reduction devices is limited by the size of the ship. In this paper, we design a marine rocking reduction device based on the control torque gyro, analyze the principle of the gyro stabilizer, and combine the gyro stabilizer with the 4-RPU parallel mechanism to realize the shaking reduction of the ship and the shipboard equipment. We establish a three-dimensional model, and simulate the dynamics and process the assembled prototype for experiments. The results show that when the ship produces 30° transverse rocking motion, the rocking reduction device we designed can achieve 93% rocking reduction effect on the target platform, and compared with the traditional rocking reduction equipment, the rocking reduction effect of this equipment is increased by 9%.

articleTitle: Design of an S-type elastic composite fiber optic vibration sensor
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: This article focuses on the background of real-time safety monitoring of low-frequency vibration signals generated in key parts of large-scale engineering such as water turbine units. A fiber optic grating vibration sensor based on S-shaped elastomers and wedge-shaped beams as elastic sensitive components is designed, and an elastic theoretical model of its vibration sensitive component is established. The finite element numerical model is used to optimize the parameters of the vibration sensitive component and conduct static analysis. An experimental platform is built to conduct vibration performance related tests. The research shows that the designed fiber optic grating vibration sensor has functions such as ultra-low frequency pickup, high sensitivity feedback, and temperature adaptive compensation. The pickup frequency of the sensor can be as low as 0.5Hz, with a pickup sensitivity of up to 789pm/g and a nonlinear error of less than 2%. The sensor group can be formed by using wavelength division multiplexing technology to form a quasi distributed chain. Network monitoring, it can solve the technical problem of achieving ultra-low frequency vibration safety monitoring in large projects such as water turbine units under strong electromagnetic interference.

articleTitle: Equivalent conductivity measurement methods for mixed non-homogeneous media
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of complicated electrode deployment and uncertain measurement range under a non-uniform medium in the "current-voltage" four-terminal method of conductivity measurement, a two-electrode equivalent conductivity measurement method based on the ground current field transport model is proposed. The "air-ground" layered medium ground current field transmission model is constructed, the equivalent conductivity model is further derived, the model error is corrected, and the simulation results show that the measurement accuracy of the uniform medium reaches 99%; the measurement results of the mixed non-uniform medium are in line with the theory; the dielectric conductivity increases firstly with the increase of the medium volume and then tends to be stable, and the measurement range of conductivity can be roughly determined accordingly. Under the two dry clay and soil environments, the measurement results are consistent with the soil EC value detector, which meets the application requirements.

articleTitle: Research on the systematic architecture of nuclear safety management for nuclear power plants based on cloud platform
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: Analysed the main content of nuclear safety management in nuclear power plants(NPPs). In response to the complexity of nuclear safety management work, in order to coordinate various affairs related to the management, use, and support of NPPs, including law and regulatory(L&R) construction, human factors, operation, use, maintenance, material replacement, nuclear emergency, experience feedback, technical support, and information management, a linkage mechanism for nuclear safety supervision, support, and management of NPPs is formed, fundamentally ensuring the safety of NPPs. A systematic intelligent and wisdom management system architecture for nuclear safety based on cloud platform linkage mechanism is proposed. This system architecture includes application functions such as cloud computing based nuclear safety big data analysis, intelligent decision support, nuclear emergency management, nuclear safety affair management, and cloud conference management. Through cloud platforms, accurate, refined, optimized, and efficient management of nuclear safety can be achieved.

articleTitle: Processing and analysis of rotary drilling tool angular velocity signals based on dynamic mode decomposition
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: Developing a signal processing algorithm for downhole drilling operations based on the dynamic mode decomposition method is essential for suppressing measurement noise from drilling instruments and improving the accuracy of numerical differentiation estimates in low signal-to-noise ratio conditions. When analyzing the twisting of the drill string, it is necessary to calculate angular acceleration through angular velocity measurements. However, numerical differentiation may amplify noise in the data, and filtering noise could potentially suppress critical data features. Therefore, proposing the application of the Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD) algorithm for feature extraction from angular velocity measurement signals is crucial. This involves applying DMD to the time-series signals collected by sensors, extracting low-rank components from the signals using a threshold method, and reconstructing denoised signals for improved data quality. In the experimental research of simulated signals, the processed measurement signal matches the theoretical signal curve. Additionally, the processed measurement signal reduces root mean square error, improves signal-to-noise ratio, and decreases numerical differentiation estimation error.

articleTitle: The torque prediction of heavy-duty vehicle driveshaft based on MSGWO-LSTM
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: The driveshaft is the core component in the driveline system of Heavy-Duty Vehicles (HDV). Its torque transfer performance is related to the operational capability. The torque prediction is of great significance for studying the dynamics of HDV. Therefore, this paper proposes a driveshaft torque prediction model using a Multi-Strategy Grey Wolf Optimizer (MSGWO) to optimize the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network. First, a torque calculation method based on real vehicle sensing data is proposed to provide samples for neural network training. Second, the MSGWO is used to optimize the hyperparameters of LSTM to construct the prediction model based on MSGWO-LSTM. Finally, the model is validated using a dataset composed of real vehicle sensing data and calculated torque. Compared to GWO-LSTM, LSTM, and Backpropagation (BP) models, the MSGWO-LSTM model proposed in this paper reduces the RMSE of real-time shifting torque prediction values by 41.59%, 66.14%, and 86.78%, respectively. The RMSE of short mileage prediction value decreases by 43.63%, 62.22%, and 68.92%, respectively. The results show that the model has high prediction accuracy and can effectively predict the torque of the HDV driveshaft.

articleTitle: Fast detection algorithm based on YOLOv8 with structural reparameterisation and grouped convolutional heads
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: As autonomous driving technology advances swiftly, the precise identification of road signs has become essential for enabling autonomous driving. This paper introduces an enhanced YOLOv8 model for road sign recognition. This model enhances the original C2f module by incorporating the RepViT Block, resulting in the C2f_RVB module. This alteration not only hastens the convergence rate of the model but also markedly boosts detection precision. Furthermore, we introduce a highly efficient architectural framework utilizing lightweight ViTs, which augments the model's detection speed while minimizing the parameter count. Lastly, we incorporate grouped convolution to enhance the detection head of YOLOv8. Tests were conducted utilizing the Street Sign Locator dataset, which was improved with information from the Roboflow stage. The exploratory comes about illustrate that the proposed RVB-YOLOv8 demonstrate accomplishes critical upgrades in discovery measurements like mAP and FLOPs when compared to the initial YOLOv8 demonstrate, whereas too diminishing the number of parameters by one-third.

articleTitle: Optimization of the single crystal silicon nano-positioning stage in X-ray interferometer
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: To address the prevalent issues of excessive lateral angular displacement and low interference signal contrast in current X-ray interferometry nano-motion platforms, this paper presents an innovative hinge structure design. The design features a symmetrical flexible hinge, with its geometric parameters meticulously optimized through finite element analysis, including length, width, and thickness. By fine-tuning these parameters, the design aims to minimize the displacement of the motion platform along both the X and Y axes, thereby ensuring precise beam alignment and enhancing the contrast of the interference signal. Simulation results confirm that the optimized hinge structure effectively reduces the displacement of the motion platform along the X and Y axes, significantly lowering the lateral angular displacement and improving the interference signal contrast. This optimized design not only enhances the measurement accuracy and stability of X-ray interferometers but also provides strong technical support for expanding their application scope. As a high-precision nanoscale measurement tool, X-ray interferometers have extensive application prospects in fields such as surface morphology, film thickness, and lattice parameter measurement. The optimized hinge structure design offers a more reliable technical guarantee for the application of X-ray interferometers in these fields. Additionally, the high-precision motion control capabilities of the design also hold potential for application in other fields requiring high-precision motion control.

articleTitle: Study on the sensitivity mechanism of low-coupled heat flow biaxial MEMS accelerometers
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: A new sensitive structure of a low-coupling heat flow biaxial MEMS accelerometer is proposed and its sensitivity mechanism is investigated. A three-dimensional model of the sensitive structure was created by COMSOL, and the temperature field of the sensitive structure was calculated using the finite element method. The results show that the accelerometer has a temperature sensitivity of 1.71 K·g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>in the X-axis, 1.69 K·g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>in the Y-axis, 0.7% cross-coupling, and the sensitivity of both X-axis and Y-axes was 1.5 mV·g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>with a heater power of 5mW and an acceleration of [-1~1] g. The accelerometer is characterized by a high sensitivity and a low cross-coupling, which lays a theoretical basis for the optimization of the structure in the following years.

articleTitle: Study on response time ofZ-axis thermal expansion flow gyroscope
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: This paper presents a method to derive the gyro response time of thermal expansion flow in Z-axis micro-electro-mechanical systems (MEMS). First, the structure of the thermal expansion gyro is given and its working principle is explained in detail. Secondly, according to the sensitive mechanism of the thermal expansion gyro and its heat transfer mode, the theoretical model of the response time of the thermal expansion gyro is derived, and the calculation formula of the response time of the thermal expansion gyro is given. Finally, in order to verify the response time calculation formula derived in this paper, the finite element method is used. Based on the three-dimensional physical model of the thermal expansion gyro, the theoretical response time of the gyro is calculated and verified. The results of calculation and finite element verification show that: (1) the theoretical model and formula of response time of thermal expansion gyro are in agreement with the verification data; (2) With the increase of the thermal conductivity of the gas, the area of the thermal wire, and the decrease of the specific heat capacity and density of the gas, the response time gradually decreases. (3) The gyro response time calculated for Z-axis thermal expansion flow is 669.88 ms. The formula for calculating the response time of thermal expansion gyro presented in this paper lays a theoretical foundation for optimizing the response time of thermal expansion gyro.

articleTitle: Investigation of autonomous ground current field injection signal characteristics
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: Autonomous injection of signals to generate ground current field technology is used to realize signal transmission by injecting signals into the ground to form a ground current field. In this paper, horizontal double electrodes are used to inject the signal into the ground, and the model of the ground equivalent electrical network is established according to the circuit characteristics, and the signal transmission characteristics are simulated and analyzed. In order to verify the penetration ability of different signals, square wave, sine wave and triangle wave are injected into the ground, and the signals are received at 13m and 18m and processed and analyzed. The results show that the square wave has the best penetration, followed by the sine wave and finally the triangle wave, which is consistent with the simulation results and verifies the accuracy of the model and the signal penetration ability in the medium.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis method based on the timesnet model under variable speed and strong noise
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: Aiming at the fault diagnosis of rotating machinery in industrial production, which faces the problems of signal noise, variable speed and other interferences that lead to inconspicuous fault features, and the traditional methods rely on manual experience for feature extraction and lack of robustness, the present study introduces a novel fault diagnosis approach utilizing the TimesNet model. This method takes the temporal multi-periodicity as the starting point, and the one-dimensional original signal is divided into multiple two-dimensional signals by different sizes of the period respectively. Subsequently, Inception-Attention modeling is applied to extract intricate time and space information. The experiments use the planetary gearbox dataset to verify the influence of different parameters and structures of TimesNet on the diagnostic effect, and carry out comparative tests with five time-series classification models, which provide some reference value for the application of TimesNet in fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Research on gait recognition by using 1DCNN based on lower limb kinematic posture data
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: Gait recognition refers to the process of realizing the detection of human identity or health status and other information according to the characteristics of human plantar pressure, video images or human dynamics indicators. With the advantages of non-contact, non-aggression, no need for cooperation and easy to collect, gait recognition technology has been widely used in recent years in the field of public security criminal investigation, medical care, intelligent transportation and other fields. In this study, to meet the needs of gait recognition, IMU sensors are used to acquire human lower limb motion posture data and wavelet transform is used to decompose several components. Then the components were determined and the optimized 1DCNN model is used to carry out gait recognition research. The results showed that the optimized 1DCNN model for gait recognition task exhibits excellent performance with up to 95% accuracy, 96% recall and F1 value, as well as good computational efficiency, which is valuable for clinical automatic gait recognition analysis, rehabilitation engineering and criminal investigation work. Although there are some errors in some gait classifications, our study provides directions for further optimization of the algorithm to improve the accuracy and robustness of gait recognition.

articleTitle: An investigation of the factors affecting the sensitivity of a MEMS gyro with four sets of bidirectional thermal expansion flows
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: In this paper, Factors affecting the sensitivity of a MEMS gyro with four sets of bi-directional thermal expansion flows, such as the duty cycle of the heating signal, in order to optimize the operating parameters and enhance performance, the upper chamber gas and other factors are investigated. The variation of the temperature field of the sensitive element is analysed and verified by calculations using COMSOL software, while a 3D model of the gyro is established. The optimized calculation results demonstrate that, under the conditions of the ideal heater frequency of 10 Hz, duty cycle of 60%, and power of 70 mW, the optimized MEMS thermal expansion flow gyroscope has a structural sensitivity of 23.5 mK/°/s when the input angular velocity is in the range of [-400°/s, 400°/s], using the upper chamber with a larger volume and Ar as the upper chamber's warming gas. The nonlinearity is 2.984%. The numerical analysis results extend the idea for the preparation and exploration of the same type of gyro in the future.

articleTitle: Design of position sensorless high-speed PMSM controller based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: Aiming at the development requirements of miniaturization and high performance of motor controller, a miniaturized high-speed permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) controller without position sensors based on FPGA is designed in this paper. The motor controller uses a three-phase full-bridge inverter circuit to drive and control the PMSM to achieve a rated speed of 60000r/min. The motor controller replaces the position sensors to realize the motor commutation detection by means of back electromotive force(back-EMF) zero-crossing detection, and realizes the motor three-phase winding current detection by sampling and reconstructing the bus current. The three-stage starting control method is adopted by the motor controller to achieve high reliability starting of the PMSM. Finally, the stable control of a PMSM with a rated speed of 60000 r/min is realized. The start-stop tests and running-in tests were designed to verify high reliability and speed stability control of the motor controller in this paper. The results of the start-stop tests and running-in tests show that the motor controller not only can control the PMSM to achieve high reliability start-stop control function, but also can achieve short-term and long-term stability control of 60000 r/min speed. The speed stability of PMSM has good consistency and is between 4.32×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−7</sup>and 4.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−7</sup>.

articleTitle: Analysis and research on jitter based on eye diagram measurement of broadband sampling oscilloscope
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: The broadband sampling oscilloscope is the most important instrument for time-domain measurements of signals. However, as the demand for precise signal measurements increases, the jitter of broadband sampling oscilloscopes is becoming a growing concern. Jitter not only reduces the clarity of the signal but also cause waveform distortion, thereby affecting the assessment of signal quality and system performance. In this paper, the jitter under the eye diagram measurements of sampling oscilloscope was investigated. Firstly, the eye diagram and the characterisation of jitter in eye diagram were studied, including the construction of the eye diagram based on the equivalent-time sampling technique, the impact of sampling oscilloscope’s jitter on the eye diagram, and the calculation methods of jitter under eye diagram measurements. Then, the impact of sampling clock jitter, noise, as well as measurement conditions on jitter measurements were investigated., where measurement conditions include setting sensitivity on oscilloscope, the amplitude and frequency of the measured signal, the number of sampling points, and the orders of the code types. Finally, the influences on the measurement of jitter were verified by constructing the actual measurement system.

articleTitle: Fusion dynamic model based fault tolerant control for collaborative robot manipulators
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: In the rapidly developing field of robot manipulators, there are many applications that go beyond the capabilities of a single robot manipulator, and these applications involve a wide range of fields, such as grasping objects of any shape, handling large or heavy objects, matching suitable parts, and other tasks. Therefore, the collaborative working mode of multiple robot manipulators has emerged. The research object of this article is a collaborative system of multiple planar robot manipulators jointly gripping an object. However, unlike ordinary nonlinear systems with many mature solutions, manipulator systems have their own characteristics, that is, nonholonomic constraints. This is a non-integrable constraint imposed on motion. Angular momentum is a typical non-integrable conserved quantity, so the systems with rolling constraint and mechanical systems with sliding constraint are common systems with non-integrable first order constraint. Firstly, a decentralized dynamic model is constructed to describe the fusion system between a planar robot manipulator and the clamped object. Secondly, a fault-tolerant control scheme based on sliding mode control is designed for actuator additive fault. Finally, an example of a planar robot manipulators with three joints and an object being gripped is taken to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: Angle measurement technology of hatch door based on multi-line LiDAR
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: The opening angle of the aircraft hatch door is crucial for ensuring weapon delivery safety and serves as a necessary test subject in flight testing. Currently, the angle measurement of the hatch door can only determine its open or closed state without providing quantitative measurements. The traditional method of measuring the control mechanism's angle in flight tests involves installing a contact line displacement sensor at the linkage mechanism, which is not suitable for small locations. This paper presents a designed multi-line LiDAR system to address these issues. By scanning the hatch door with multi-line LiDAR, three-dimensional point cloud data is obtained and subjected to feature extraction and normalization processing under different open and closed states, enabling accurate acquisition of the hatch door's opening angle. This method eliminates the need for installing contact sensors on the linkage mechanism, thereby ensuring test safety. Additionally, by utilizing an RANSAC algorithm to fit point cloud data, model accuracy is enhanced leading to improved test precision. In this paper, the reflector plate is used to replace the hatch door for laboratory verification test. The test results show that the multi-line LiDAR system has high measurement accuracy and can be put into practical application.

articleTitle: Channel mismatch calibration for multicoset sampling
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: Multicoset sampling is a sub-Nyquist sampling technique, which can break through the limitation of sampling theorem for sparse signal acquisition. Multicoset sampling is implemented with the parallel channels. In practical application, due to non-ideality existed in the circuitry, the channels of multicoset sampling cannot be implemented identically, and this difference will result in the mismatch between the channels. Due to the mismatch of sampling channels, the model of signal reconstruction will not be able to descript the practical circuit model, and the performance of Multicoset sampling is degraded. The gain and phase differences are the main issues of the multicoset sampling system. In this paper, the gain and phase mismatches are considered, and the impact of channel mismatch is analysed. In order to calibrate the mismatch, the signal reconstruction model with channel mismatch is constructed. The constructed model can accurately reflect the behaviour of the multicoset sampling circuitry system. With the constructed analysis model, the channel mismatch can be calibrated. The simulation experiments are performed to evaluate the calibration model for the channel mismatch of the multicoset sampling, and the satisfactory results demonstrate the feasibility of proposed calibration method.

articleTitle: DFT-spread combined with PTS method to reduce the PAPR in RADCOM system
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: In radar communication integration (RADCOM) systems based on orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) technology, high peak to average power ratio (PAPR) is one of the main factors affecting system performance. This article analyses the PAPR probability distribution of radar communication integrated signals based on OFDM. In order to reduce the PAPR of integrated signals, the discrete Fourier transform spread spectrum (DFT Spread) technology suitable for traditional OFDM systems has been improved and combined with partial transmission sequences (PTS) to further reduce the PAPR of radar communication integrated signals. The simulation results show that compared with using DFT spread spectrum technology alone, PTS technology alone, and the original signal, the proposed DFT PTS joint algorithm based on linear interpolation reduces PAPR by 1.5 dB, 2.4 dB, and at least 4.1 dB, respectively. Obviously, the DFT-PTS joint algorithm achieved the best PAPR suppression effect.

articleTitle: Preparation of triboelectric flexible sensor and its application in pulse detection
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: The PDMS/GO composite film with porous structure was successfully prepared by sacrificial template method. The output performance test and morphology characterization analysis of composite films with different sacrificial particle sizes, different thicknesses and different mass fractions of graphene oxide (GO) were carried out. The optimal particle size and thickness were 63 ~ 75 μm and 3 mm, respectively, and the optimal doping ratio was 10wt %, and the triboelectric flexible sensor array was prepared. Design signal conversion circuit, power module, reset circuit, gating circuit, and upload to the host computer to process data and display. In the process of pulse signal acquisition, five groups of pulse data were collected from four students, and the collected data were analyzed and compared. The experimental results show that the five groups of pulse data of each student are almost consistent, and the influence of the subjects ' breathing and other subtle factors during the test will lead to different test results. Through the overall analysis, the overall difference value of the data is small, and the maximum difference is within0.15V. It shows that the sensor performs well in terms of sensitivity and repeatability.

articleTitle: A study of a novel oil wear particle detection sensor based on magnetic yoke
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: Metal particle detection in lubricating oil effectively identifies the health condition of mechanical equipment. However, the existing planar inductance coil for detecting metal particles has a low magnetic field strength, which reduces its detection sensitivity. To address this issue, this paper studies planar inductance and proposes a method to improve sensor performance by changing the form and position of the magnetic yoke. By adding a magnetic yoke on both sides of the axis of the planar inductance coil, the intensity of the surrounding magnetic field is altered, leading to improved sensitivity and reduced measurement errors caused by positional differences. Furthermore, the COMSOL simulation method is applied to optimize the magnetic yoke addition and geometric parameters, and an inductance detection verification test is conducted to evaluate sensor performance. Results demonstrate that under the same conditions, the detection signal amplitude increases by approximately 84.7%, the fluctuation rate decreased by 14.16%, and the detection amplitude increases while error decreases. The method proposes in this paper effectively enhances sensor detection sensitivity and can be applied to lubricating oil detection in mechanical equipment.

articleTitle: Geant4 simulation and XCOM theory in CT contrast agents mass attenuation coefficient research
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: Contrast agents play a crucial role in medical imaging by enhancing the absorption and scattering of photons in target tissues. Radiologists need to understand the attenuation characteristics of contrast agents to make accurate diagnoses. In this study, we focused on the mass attenuation coefficients of ioversol (C18H24I3N3O9) and barium sulfate (BaSO4), which are widely used in computed tomography (CT) imaging. We employed Geant4, a Monte Carlo particle transport simulation tool, to calculate the mass attenuation coefficients of these contrast agents across the energy range of 20 keV to 70 keV. The simulated values were compared with theoretical results obtained from the XCOM program. The results showed that the mass attenuation coefficients of iodixanol and barium sulfate exhibited a trend of increasing initially, and then sharply increases at the absorption edge before decreasing again. This trend is consistent with the absorption edge of iodine at 33.1 keV. The comparison between the Geant4 simulations and the XCOM program results revealed a small deviation, with the maximum difference being less than 0.05. Our study demonstrates the feasibility and accuracy of using Geant4 simulations to study the mass attenuation coefficients of CT contrast agents. The findings provide valuable insights for optimizing CT imaging techniques and improving contrast agent design. Future research may involve further optimization of simulation parameters and exploration of mass attenuation coefficients for other contrast agents to support the development of medical imaging.

articleTitle: Lower limb gait recognition method based on knowledge distillation
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: The need for assistive devices such as lower limb exoskeletons is steadily growing, making quick and precise gait recognition essential for optimal operation of these apparatuses. The knowledge distillation method was applied to gait recognition in this work. First, we took participant lower limb gait data, which we then resampled with step frequency taken into account. Next, multi-layer perceptron (MLP) with distinct layers were modeled by educators and students. The process of knowledge distillation was used to improve the accuracy of participant activity recognition by transferring knowledge from the sophisticated teacher model to the lightweight student model. On the training set, the teacher model's accuracy average was 96.4%. Following the process of knowledge distillation, the accuracy of the student model was 95.48%, representing a 1.12% improvement compared to the non-distilled model, with only 0.53M parameters and shorter training duration. The results demonstrate that knowledge distillation can improve the recognition speed and stability of gait recognition models, enabling more accurate and reliable results within the same patient population, thus providing more effective support for medical diagnosis and rehabilitation treatment.

articleTitle: Telemetry data-based spacecraft space traffic warning algorithm research
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: With the explosive growth of global spacecraft in orbit, the frequency of space security events is getting higher and higher, in order to guarantee the traffic safety of spacecraft in orbit, a more accurate and efficient space traffic warning method is needed as a support. In this paper, a spacecraft space traffic warning algorithm based on telemetry data is proposed to address the problems of long cycle time and high false alarm rate in the current routinely applied on-orbit space traffic warning methods. The algorithm can effectively control the warning error and improve the accuracy and efficiency of the warning by effectively combining the orbit maneuvering strategy data of spacecraft autonomous planning and the space target observation data of autonomous detection and sensing on the basis of making full use of the increasingly perfect external situational awareness and orbit determination information. Finally, the practicality analysis of the method is completed by simulation verification, combining the propulsion capability of the spacecraft itself and the detection capability of the sensing load.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of reservoir profiling water quality monitoring sensor
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: Water stratification is a typical feature of the ecosystem in the reservoir area. It is of great significance for the study of water environment in the reservoir area to realize the water quality monitoring of different vertical profiles in the reservoir area. According to the requirements of in-situ monitoring of water quality in reservoir section and the application requirements of profile water quality monitoring system, an integrated multi-parameter water quality sensor which can realize in-situ monitoring of water temperature, pH, dissolved oxygen, conductivity and chlorophyll a is designed. The sensor adopts modular and intensive design method, which is small in size and convenient in maintenance. The measurement principle and design method of the sensor are introduced, and the performance of the sensor is tested according to the relevant standards and application requirements. The test results show that the performance of the sensor meets the requirements of relevant standards, and can meet the requirements of water pressure resistance in 250 meters water depth, which can be better applied to the water quality monitoring requirements of large water depth.

articleTitle: Measurement and control of temperature characteristics of piezoelectric composites
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: Type 1-3 piezoelectric composite vibrators are commonly used in hydroacoustic detection, nondestructive flaw detection and medical ultrasound due to their high electromechanical characteristics and high stability. The temperature stability of piezoelectric composites is one of the key issues in the design of piezoelectric composites due to the large difference in the temperature characteristics of the polymer and piezoelectric ceramic phases, and the research on the testing method of the temperature deformation of piezoelectric composite oscillators can provide a reliable basis for the screening of piezoelectric composite oscillators for transducers, and promote the improvement of the piezoelectric composite oscillator design and preparation process, which has great significance for the performance enhancement of the transducer and the sonar system. It is of great significance for the improvement of transducer and sonar system performance. In this paper, the temperature characteristics of six piezoelectric composites with different polymer phases are compared, and the results show that the 9110B and 9110W silicone piezoelectric composites have better temperature stability. The relative change in frequency constant of 9110B silicone piezoelectric composite is 0.12 and the relative change in dielectric constant is 2.29 under the variable temperature environment from 25℃ to 120℃.

articleTitle: Membrane-based fibre Fabry-Perot cavity hydrophone with high sensitivity
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: In this paper, a high-sensitivity fibre Fabry Perot (FP) cavity hydrophone is investigated, which uses a metal film as the sensitive acoustic wave element. The end face of the optical fibre is coated with a high refractive index dielectric film to form an interference structure of the FP cavity. And water is used to fill the FP cavity to balance the pressure difference between the inside and outside of the cavity. The sensitivity, frequency response, and hydrostatic pressure resistance of fibre FP cavity hydrophones are characterized with self-built setup. The membrane-based fibre FP cavity hydrophone showed a high sensitivity of -137 dB re 1V/μPa@100 Hz, and can withstand hydrostatic pressure up to 120 Mpa, which is a depth of 12000 m water.

articleTitle: Relational attention network for few-shot fault diagnosis of rotating machinery
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: In practical rotating machinery fault diagnosis (FD) tasks, the scarcity of labeled fault data often impedes the model’s ability to learn effective classification boundaries, resulting in poor performance with limited training samples. To address this issue, this paper introduces a rotation machinery few-shot FD algorithm based on a Relational Attention Network (RAN). The network comprises four modules: feature embedding, feature concatenation, attention computation, and relation computation. RAN achieves a large-margin feature space by utilizing extended concatenation and attention on feature pairs. Specifically, the feature embedding module extracts signal features and constructs both a prototype-query feature pair matrix and a query-query feature pair matrix. Subsequently, the attention computation module assigns higher weights to indistinguishable heterogeneous feature pairs within the two matrices. Finally, the attention-weighted feature pair matrices are fed into the relation computation module to generate a relation score matrix. The effectiveness and superiority of this method were validated on a bearing fault dataset. Experimental results demonstrate that RAN outperforms various comparison methods in recognition accuracy under limited training sample conditions.

articleTitle: Research on quantification and modeling of multiple constraints for communication satellite module layout
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: The layout design of communication satellite is a complex iterative design process, which involves all satellite subsystems and products. As the top-level work of satellite design, the layout affects the performances of the whole satellite. The layout design is to place a given layout in one (or more) limited structure space according to certain geometric and functional restrictions, and the result needs to meet the conditions of each constraint. This paper will be oriented to the layout design of communication satellite module, comb the layout design process and elements. The paper presents the constraint condition quantitatively and studies the construction of the digital model of layout design. The intelligent algorithm is used for automatic layout optimization design with multi-constraint solution, which improves the efficiency and quality of layout design and meets the requirements of large-scale satellite development.

articleTitle: Research on double cubic interpolation combined with Gaussian fitting sub-pixel edge detection method
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: With the rapid advancements in intelligent manufacturing technology, the realization of fast and accurate measurements in aerospace, instrumentation, machinery and equipment, automotive electronics, and other sectors has become a research hotspot. Image positioning technology and edge detection methods, with their advantages of being fast, non-contact, and precise, have been widely employed. How to improve the accuracy of image measurement lies in solving the problem of accurate positioning of image edge detection, based on the problem of inaccurate extraction of directional information and large error in contour size of image edge detection technology proposes an improved sub-pixel edge detection algorithm with Gaussian fitting by double cubic interpolation. Based on preprocessing for pixel-level edge feature extraction, pixel-level edge points are acquired utilizing the least squares fitting algorithm. The normal section is determined by computing the normal intercept line, while the normal isometric line is identified through the Gaussian integration method. Sub-pixel fitting points are obtained via boundary fitting, and the final grey value is derived using an edge detection algorithm that combines double cubic interpolation and Gaussian fitting on the fitted points. The experimental results demonstrate that, through comparative testing of this method, it has been verified that it exhibits the highest image quality and is superior to most current algorithms. An improvement in the algorithm by 0.021%, 0.025%, and 0.031% in edge localization accuracy compared to the Zernike moment algorithm, Gaussian fitting algorithm, and bicubic interpolation algorithm has been achieved, effectively verifying that the image quality detected by this method is relatively high. In comparison with the point cloud method regarding fitting error, it was observed that the error index increased by 0.025% under strong burst light conditions, 0.026% under normal burst light conditions, and 0.022% under weak burst light conditions. The speed of processing data was doubled, further demonstrating the superiority of this method.

articleTitle: A noise suppression method based on Wasserstein GAN model
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: Noise suppression in a receiver system, such as a signal analyser, is fundamental for ensuring accurate and reliable signal measurement and analysis. Effective methods play a pivotal role in enhancing the dynamic range and sensitivity of the instrument, which is crucial for the detection and characterisation of weak signals that might otherwise be obscured by noise and interference. This paper introduces an innovative noise suppression approach using a Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Network (WGAN) model. The model is trained with real noise data to generate synthetic noise samples that closely mimic the actual noise. A specially designed activation function addresses the tiny but high-frequency oscillations present in noise data, while Kernel Density Estimate is used to handle inconsistencies across different datasets and reduce the randomness in generated samples. Both techniques improve the robustness of the model. By employing these generated samples, the receiver system can perform real-time numerical noise suppression, significantly improving the accuracy and efficiency of signal measurements compared to the present method. The advancement is vital across various applications, particularly in fields requiring high precision, such as wireless communications and aerospace. It broadens the scope for more precise and reliable signal analysis in complex environments.

articleTitle: Research on autonomous interval maintenance in collaborative flight of unmanned aerial vehicles
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: This study investigates the use of the Vicsek model for maintaining autonomous intervals in the cooperative flight of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). Although the Vicsek model effectively simulates group movement, it does not inherently maintain safe intervals between drones. To address this limitation, we propose an enhanced approach that incorporates a speed adaptive mechanism and a repulsive force mechanism. The speed adaptive mechanism dynamically adjusts the drone's speed based on its proximity to neighboring drones, slowing down when in close proximity and speeding up when further apart, thus preventing collisions. Additionally, the repulsive force mechanism ensures that drones maintain a safe distance from each other, even in high-density areas, thereby avoiding clustering and maintaining formation stability. Our simulation results indicate that drones equipped with these mechanisms achieve direction and speed consistency more rapidly, effectively avoid collisions in dense environments, and enhance overall movement speed and task execution efficiency. This approach provides a robust solution for autonomous interval maintenance in UAV swarms, ensuring safe and efficient collaborative operations in complex environments. The findings of this study contribute significantly to the field of UAV collaborative flight, offering practical implications for military reconnaissance, agricultural management, logistics, and disaster relief applications.

articleTitle: Portable electrochemical sensor based on molecularly imprinted polymer for oxytetracycline detection
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: Reduced graphene oxide (rGO) plays a critical role in enhancing the performance of electrochemical sensors through its excellent electrical conductivity, large surface area, ease of functionalization, chemical stability, and synergy with other nanomaterials. In this paper, A novel electrochemical sensor was developed based on rGO and molecularly imprinted polymer (MIP) for detection of trace oxytetracycline (OTC) in water. The MIP/rGO composites are synthesized by in-situ electrochemical modification on a disposable screen-printed electrode (SPE). Due to the large surface area and good electron transport rate of rGO, as well as the specific recognition for TC of MIP, the sensitive determination of trace TC at MIP/rGO/SPE was realized. Linear sweep voltammetry (LSV) was performed on the sensor for the electrochemical analysis of OTC. Under optimized conditions, the peak current of MIP/rGO/SPE exhibited a good linear correlation with OTC concentration in a wide linear range (1-25 µmol/L), possessed a detection limit of 0.34 µmol/L. Spiked detection of OTC was applied for the sensor in actual water samples, with relative standard deviations (RSDs) of 93.2%-108.7%. These results indicate that the proposed MIP/rGO/SPE sensor has the ability to accurately, rapidly and selectively detect OTC in water samples.

articleTitle: Lightweight semi-open magnetic shielding room based on finite element method
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: Lightweight magnetic shielding room (MSR) requires less material, is lighter, more mobile and more cost effective. It will provide a viable solution for portable mobile biomagnetic measurement equipments. In this paper, a semi-open lightweight MSR is proposed based on the finite element method. It uses 30% less permalloy compared to conventional magnetic shielding chambers. We analysed the internal residual magnetism distribution of MSRs under different hole distribution methods through finite element simulation, through which we optimized the structure of MSRs and machined and designed the semi-open MSR. The design has a shielding factor of 26 at 0.1 Hz magnetic field, which is close to the shielding factor of a conventional closed MSR, and provides better ventilation and lighting performance.

articleTitle: A pseudo-random signal generator based on 3D discrete memristor chaotic map
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: Pseudo-random number generators that can quickly generate noise-like noise have high value in engineering applications. However, the methods currently used in many signal generators do not produce noise with enough randomness to satisfy engineering applications. Based on the properties possessed by the memristor, a novel method is proposed in this paper. A 3D discrete memristor model is constructed by coupling the discrete memristor to a discrete system, and its complex dynamical behavior, which depends on the system parameters and initial values, is analyzed. The results show that the 3D-DM exhibits hyperchaotic behavior. An experimental platform was built using FPGA and DAC, and the phase-trajectory diagrams obtained using oscilloscope capture are highly similar to the simulation results, which proves the feasibility of realizing 3D-DM using digital hardware circuits. Finally, a pseudo-random number generator is designed with a hardware operation speed of 350 Mps. The proposed method outperforms the existing methods.

articleTitle: A novel fusion modeling method for the acoustic fields of diesel engine laboratories
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: The complex geometric parameters of the diesel engine, the ancillary equipment, and the pipe system make it difficult to establish an accurate acoustic field model of a reference diesel engine laboratory using 3D geometric modelling. A novel fusion modeling method based on machine vision and 3D geometric modeling is proposed to achieve efficient and accurate modeling for the acoustic field of the diesel engine laboratory. Firstly, an enhanced scale-invariant feature transform algorithm and an enhanced random sample consensus algorithm are proposed for the machine vision-based modeling of the diesel engine, the ancillary equipment, and the pipe system. Then, the laboratory walls and the engine bench with simple geometric parameters are modeled by CATIA software. Finally, the two types of models are fused according to the location relationships and are converted into an acoustic field model. Experimental results show the geometric dimensions and sound pressure levels errors of the reconstructed model are less than 0.5% and 2.5 dB, respectively, this indicates that the proposed method can accurately model the acoustic field of the reference diesel engine laboratory without complex geometric parameters.

articleTitle: Research on three-dimensional fusion method of surveillance video in smart park
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: The three-dimensional video fusion technology is increasingly becoming an important part of smart parks. In previous security work, surveillance videos are typically displayed in a multi-screen layout, making it difficult to directly analyze the spatial positions of scenes and objects in the monitoring footage. Based on this, a real-time fusion rendering method for RTSP video streams and three-dimensional park models is proposed, which uses texture projection to integrate real videos into virtual three-dimensional models, achieving the fusion of multiple video sources. For scenarios with multiple videos at the same location, a viewpoint-based weighted method is adopted to achieve texture overlay rendering. Finally, a smart park surveillance video fusion platform is built based on the Three.js framework, supporting real-time rendering on the web. The system also provides various interaction methods, including roaming and viewpoint switching, making it convenient for personnel to monitor key areas. Simultaneously, it achieves the effect of roaming in virtual three-dimensional scenes, enhancing the stereoscopic presentation of real scenes in surveillance videos. The system demonstration proves that effectively combining real-time surveillance videos with three-dimensional models results in better spatial presentation of videos and enhances the ability to discern the actual positions of scenes within the smart park.

articleTitle: Short-term traffic flow forecasting using adaptive echo state networks
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: In recent years, with the increase in vehicle volume, the traffic system has been inconvenienced. Therefore, the timeliness and accuracy of traffic flow prediction are crucial to the overall efficiency of the traffic system. Echo state network (ESN) has attracted extensive attention in the field of time series and traffic flow prediction due to its simple concept, low computational cost and simplicity. However, the traditional ESN model has certain limitations in terms of prediction accuracy and stability when facing complex and changeable traffic flow data. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes an ESN prediction model combined with adaptive optimization. The simulated annealing algorithm is used to optimize the configuration of several important parameters of ESN, thereby improving the prediction performance and stability of the model. The experimental results show that the optimized ESN model is significantly better than the traditional ESN method in terms of prediction accuracy and stability. The monthly mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) is reduced from 10.05% to 6.6%, and the average error of each detector is reduced from 9.5% to 6.61%. This study proposes a more efficient and reliable method for short-term traffic flow prediction, which shows potential value in practical applications.

articleTitle: FIR filter based voltage-current phase calibration method for power analysers
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: Aiming at the difficult problem of low sampling rate of high-resolution ADC in power analysis, this paper proposes a real-time voltage and current phase correction method based on an FIR digital filter. The homologous clock technique is used to achieve multi-channel data acquisition synchronization. The combination of integer and fractional parts in a high precision phase correction approach is discussed. The FIR digital filter is implemented in FPGA using the serial-parallel combination technique. Additionally, the FIR filter only uses 4*18 KB of RAM and 4 DSP 48E1 IP cores to implement real-time filter calculation on the FPGA. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed method can achieve 1.95 ns step and a correction index of -512.5 us to +512.5 us when the sampling rate is 2 MSa/s. Good real-time performance and sparse resource usage are the main attributes of the proposed approach. The proposed method is used to get good phase correction results on a power analyzer with 2 MSa/s and 18 bits.

articleTitle: Measurement and computation method for internally generated heat in single LAYER ceramic capacitor (SLCC) in electronic circuit
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: The purpose is to deeper understand the heat generation of ceramic capacitors in electronic circuits when the voltages and frequencies there have been changed, so that the application reliability of electronic products can be improved; by the mean of experimentation, when the voltages and frequencies of Category Ⅱ single layer ceramic capacitors (SLCC) were changed, their surface temperature showed rising and dropping caused by their internally generated heat. The quick testing method is created, which aims to monitor the temperature changes of electronic components when voltage and frequency in the circuit changing. Meanwhile, the equations about the relations between temperature rise and voltage, frequency of SLCC have been discovered, when voltages and frequencies of SLCC are changed asynchronously and simultaneously in circuits. Therefore, it can be a reference provided for the engineers in the field of electronics to precisely apply SLCC when they design electronic circuit, so as to ensure the designed electronic products to be safe and reliable. Besides, it can also be a prompt detecting method when there are heat generation faults for the ceramic capacitors in circuits in practice.

articleTitle: Combining adjacent self-similarity feature and enhanced matching method for sentinel image registration
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: The accurate registration of Sentinel-2 optical images with Sentinel-1 synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images plays a critical role in remote sensing applications such as disaster management, environmental monitoring and military target identification. The distinct imaging mechanisms of the two images result in non-negligible radiometric and geometric differences, which make traditional image registration techniques suffer from insufficient correct matching points or even registration failures. To solve this problem, an optimised image registration algorithm is proposed. Firstly, First, the structural features are obtained by computing the adjacent self-similarity (ASS) features, and effectively suppress the interference of radiometric differences and speckle noise on the registration process through constructing index map and minimum self-similarity map (SSM). Subsequently, a new key-point detector is designed to restrain the local non-maximum of the minimum SSM, and a descriptor for the distribution histogram is built by log-polar grids. Finally, we employ a cascaded sample consensus (CSC) matching method that refines the search region for correct matches, leading to high accurate correspondences. In summary, our algorithm offers a comprehensive solution for image registration that improving both the number of correctly matched key-points and the overall registration accuracy, and is applicable to any complex scenario.

articleTitle: Temperature deformation testing of piezoelectric composite material
publicationTitle: 10th International Symposium on Test Automation & Instrumentation (ISTAI 2024)
abstract: The bending deformation of piezoelectric composite resonators under temperature variations can significantly impact transducers and sonar systems, yet there is a lack of research on how to assess these deformations. Investigating testing methods for the deformation of piezoelectric composite resonators at different temperatures not only provides a reliable basis for selecting resonators suitable for transducers but also advances the design and fabrication processes of relevant materials. This is crucial for enhancing the performance of transducers and sonar systems.
